input.question: How long until 3D printers can print out 3D printers?
input.ground_truth: Already, or mostly already. Look up RepRap. _URL_0_ I saw it in action a few years ago, and assume they've made headway. I think it will be a while before we see printed motors and such, but the majority of parts are simple.

Question: How long until 3D printers can print out 3D printers?

response.prediction:
Okay! Let’s imagine you have a magic box (that’s the 3D printer). This magic box can make lots of different shapes using special plastic.

Now, the question is: **"Can this magic box make another magic box just like itself?"**

Right now, the magic box can make *some* parts of another magic box, but not the whole thing all by itself. It’s like if you have a toy car, and you can use the magic box to print out some wheels and a body, but you still need someone to put them together.

But people are working really hard on this! Soon—maybe in a few years—the magic box might be able to print almost all the parts for another magic box. Then, maybe you can put them together, or even have another magic box help finish the job.

So, it won’t be *instant*, but pretty soon, 3D printers will be able to print most of the parts for another 3D printer. That’s really cool!
